t: Wagobox Pro junction box for all Wago 221 4mm² series and all single row 2773 series connectors (connectors sold separately). Fits up to 3 inline connectors or any combination of 221 side entry up to 15 conductors. Suitable for 1, 1.5 and 2.5mm twin and earth cables. Facility to accept 2 x flex up to 10mm diameter.
